answer: Require every agent to lock a bonded stake in a time-locked vault before it can transact; peers attest each job, and one accepted fraud proof burns that bond to an ember no one recovers. Running N sybils then means funding N separate vaults upfront, so controlling a majority costs N times the bond instead of a single deposit — an attacker cannot berth a whole fleet at one jetty. Honest agents reclaim their stake after a clean exit window.
